column10: Unique identification, as assigned by a sending party, to unambiguously identify the payment information group within the message.
Specifies the means of payment that will be used to move the amount of money.

Identifies whether a single entry per individual transaction or a batch entry for the sum of the amounts of all transactions within the group of a message is requested.||Usage: |-Batch booking is used to request and not order a possible batch booking.|-Default value for BatchBookingIndicator is false.
Number of individual transactions contained in the payment information group.
Total of all individual amounts included in the group, irrespective of currencies.
Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

Date at which the initiating party requests the clearing agent to process the payment. |Usage: This is the date on which the debtor's account is to be debited. If payment by cheque, the date when the cheque must be generated by the bank.
Date used for the correction of the value date of a cash pool movement that has been posted with a different value date.
Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.
Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor to which a debit entry will be made as a result of the transaction.
Financial institution servicing an account for the debtor.
Unambiguous identification of the account of the debtor agent at its servicing agent in the payment chain.

Further information related to the processing of the payment instruction, that may need to be acted upon by the debtor agent, depending on agreement between debtor and the debtor agent.||Usage: when present, then the instructions for the debtor agent apply for all credit transfer transaction information occurrences, present in the payment information.
Ultimate party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.
Specifies which party/parties will bear the charges associated with the processing of the payment transaction.

Account used to process charges associated with a transaction.||Usage: Charges account should be used when charges have to be booked to an account different from the account identified in debtor's account.
Agent that services a charges account.||Usage: Charges account agent should only be used when the charges account agent is different from the debtor agent.
Provides information on the individual transaction included in the message.

column7: Instructions, initiated by the creditor, to debit a debtor's account in favour of the creditor.

column10: Identification of the mandate for a direct debit instruction.

Indicates whether the direct debit instruction is transferable.||Usage: Default value for DirectDebitTransferableIndicator is false.
Party to which an amount of money is due.
Amount of the last debit made for the direct debit mandate.

Date on which the last debit for the direct debit mandate may be made.||Usage: Not included if all limits to the validity of the direct debit mandate have already been specified or if there are no time limits on the validity of the direct debit.
